info.name: Notes API collection
info.description:
## Notes API Collection

This collection covers the full lifecycle of interacting with the **Notes API**, hosted at `betechified-adv-bd-group1-project.onrender.com`. It includes endpoints for user authentication and complete CRUD operations on notes.

### Authentication
- **Register** – Create a new user account.
- **Login** – Authenticate and obtain an access token.

### Notes
- **Get All Notes** – Retrieve a list of all notes for the authenticated user.
- **Get a Note by ID** – Fetch a single note using its unique identifier.
- **Query Params** – Filter or search notes using query parameters.
- **Update a Note** – Modify the content of an existing note by ID.
- **Delete a Note** – Permanently remove a note by ID.

> **Note:** Most endpoints require a valid authentication token obtained from the Login request. Make sure to set it in your environment or request headers before making authenticated calls.

request.description:
## Get All Notes

Retrieves all notes belonging to the authenticated user.

---

### Endpoint

| Method | URL |
|--------|-----|
| `GET` | `https://betechified-adv-bd-group1-project.onrender.com/api/notes` |

---

### Authentication

This request requires a **Bearer Token**. Include a valid JWT token in the `Authorization` header (configured in the Auth tab).

```
Authorization: Bearer <your_token>
```

---

### Request

- **Query Parameters:** None
- **Request Body:** None

---

### Response

**Status:** `200 OK`

Returns a success message and an array of note objects.

```json
{
  "message": "Notes retrieved successfully",
  "data": [
    {
      "_id": "6aaaf0e61f52969bd2c55b2c",
      "title": "Hello notes",
      "content": "Samuel owns this note",
      "user": {
        "_id": "6aa8477802f0ed6f4f844ed5",
        "name": "Sammy",
        "email": "sammy@gmail.com"
      },
      "category": "personal",
      "createdAt": "2026-09-16T19:41:26.138Z",
      "updatedAt": "2026-09-16T21:01:20.818Z",
      "__v": 0
    }
  ]
}
```

#### Response Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `message` | `string` | A human-readable status message confirming the operation |
| `data` | `array` | List of note objects belonging to the authenticated user |
| `data[]._id` | `string` | Unique identifier for the note |
| `data[].title` | `string` | Title of the note |
| `data[].content` | `string` | Body/content of the note |
| `data[].user` | `object` | Details of the user who owns the note |
| `data[].user._id` | `string` | Unique identifier of the note owner |
| `data[].user.name` | `string` | Full name of the note owner |
| `data[].user.email` | `string` | Email address of the note owner |
| `data[].category` | `string` | Category assigned to the note (e.g. `personal`) |
| `data[].createdAt` | `string (ISO 8601)` | Timestamp when the note was created |
| `data[].updatedAt` | `string (ISO 8601)` | Timestamp when the note was last updated |
| `data[].__v` | `number` | Internal version key (MongoDB) |

## Get a Note by ID

Retrieves a single note from the system using its unique identifier.

---

### Endpoint

```
GET /api/notes/:id

 ```

---

### Path Parameter

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | Yes | The unique MongoDB ObjectID of the note to retrieve (e.g. `6aaaf0e61f52969bd2c55b2c`) |

---

### Authentication

This request requires a **Bearer Token**. Include a valid JWT token in the Authorization header (configured in the **Auth** tab).

```
Authorization: Bearer <your_token>

 ```

---

### Response

**Status:** `201 Created`

Returns a single note object belonging to the authenticated user.

#### Response Body

``` json
{
  "_id": "6aaaf0e61f52969bd2c55b2c",
  "title": "Hello notes",
  "content": "Samuel owns this note",
  "user": "6aa8477802f0ed6f4f844ed5",
  "category": "personal",
  "createdAt": "2026-09-16T19:41:26.138Z",
  "updatedAt": "2026-09-16T21:01:20.818Z",
  "__v": 0
}

 ```

#### Response Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `_id` | string | Unique identifier of the note |
| `title` | string | Title of the note |
| `content` | string | Body/content of the note |
| `user` | string | ID of the user who owns the note |
| `category` | string | Category the note belongs to (e.g. `personal`) |
| `createdAt` | string | ISO 8601 timestamp of when the note was created |
| `updatedAt` | string | ISO 8601 timestamp of the last update |
| `__v` | number | Version key (internal MongoDB field) |

**Search Notes with Query Parameters**

This request retrieves a filtered and paginated list of notes for the authenticated user. It sends a `GET` request to the Notes API with optional query parameters to search by keyword and control pagination.

**Endpoint:** `GET /api/notes`

**Query Parameters:**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `q` | string | Keyword to search notes by title, content, category, or tags. |
| `page` | number | Page number for paginated results (default: 1) |
| `limit` | number | Number of notes to return per page (default: 5) |

**Authentication:** Required (Bearer Token — configured in the Auth tab).

**Response:** Returns a success message and an array of matching note objects. Each note includes fields such as `_id`, `title`, `content`, `category`, `user`, `createdAt`, and `updatedAt`.

**Update a Note**

This request updates an existing note identified by its unique ID in the URL path. It sends a `PUT` request to the Notes API and modifies the note's details (such as title, content, and category) for the authenticated user.

**Endpoint:** `PUT /api/notes/:id`

**Path Parameter:**

- `id` — The unique identifier of the note to be updated (e.g., `6aaaf0e61f52969bd2c55b2c`).
    

**Authentication:** Required (Bearer Token — configured in the Auth tab).

**Response:** Returns a success message along with the updated note object, including fields such as `title`, `content`, `category`, `user`, `createdAt`, and `updatedAt`.

**Delete a Note**

This request deletes an existing note identified by its unique ID in the URL path. It sends a DEL request to the Notes API and deletes the note's details (such as title, content, and category) for the authenticated user.

**Endpoint:** `DEL /api/notes/:id`

**Path Parameter:**

- `id` — The unique identifier of the note to be deleted (e.g., `6aaaf0e61f52969bd2c55b2c`).
    

**Authentication:** Required (Bearer Token — configured in the Auth tab).

**Response:** Returns a success message "Note with id `6aaaf0e61f52969bd2c55b2c deleted successfully"`.
